$comment: Every route that is not a file on disk gets app.html — the EMPTY SPA shell.
It is not index.html any more: index.html is the prerendered landing page (scripts/prerender.tsx),
and pointing this at it would serve the marketing page's markup as the initial content of every
storefront. Vercel checks the filesystem before rewrites, so `/` is served by index.html directly
and never reaches this rule — which is what makes the split work.
